title: Define what to review this week
body: Define what to review this weekChoose a concrete question: which customers need follow-up this week, and which orders could face delivery risks from low stock? Create a task under Business tasks and acceptance with its goal, period and customer or order scope.Example goal: review this week’s customer follow-ups and delivery risks; list customers awaiting follow-up, orders with stock shortages, and missing information for my review.

title: State owners, deadlines and acceptance criteria
body: State owners, deadlines and acceptance criteriaFill in the owner, deadline and acceptance criteria, then save the business draft. A local owner records responsibility on this device; it does not authenticate an organization member or notify a colleague.Add: the sales lead reviews customer follow-ups and the purchasing lead checks shortages by Friday at 17:00. Each finding includes customer or order evidence, suggested action and unresolved questions.

title: Base management conclusions on business records
body: Base management conclusions on business recordsAsk the task to check CRM stages and follow-up dates, ERP stock and purchase or sale orders, and the office files you specify. Use supplied documents for delivery commitments. List information to provide if records are missing or unreadable.AI uses business tools to organize results; you review the conclusions. To inspect original records, find CRM or ERP in Settings → Side Cards and choose Open in sidebar in its feature settings.

title: Choose a review frequency and approve changes
body: Choose a review frequency and approve changesStart with One check and review its results. For recurring reviews, enter the goal in WatchDog, choose Every hour or Every day, then select Start check to create a new task. Confirm scheduling from its result; keep the app and session active.If the task requests a stock change, record deletion or order submission, inspect its scope and effects in the conversation before approving. Reject it and clarify your requirements when needed.

title: Track tasks, verify findings and follow through
body: Track tasks, verify findings and follow throughLink the actual execution session to the business task. Submit evidence locations, observation times and summaries when ready for review. Inspect sources, enter a review comment and accept the result or request rework. History preserves prior evidence.For example: reject a report missing stock evidence and ask for a new submission. An idle session does not mean completion. Only human review can accept a business task; replace inaccessible evidence before acceptance.
auxiliary: Open management, then write and start your review. Use these auxiliary settings if you need a model or chat connection; existing configuration can be reused.
